hints.title: Subarray Contiguity
hints.text: Because this requires a contiguous subarray, each element after the first two must strictly equal the sum of the immediate two predecessors.

hints.title: Running Streak
hints.text: Maintain a running streak counter initialized to 2. Increment it when the additive condition holds, or reset it to 2 on failure.

hints.title: Threshold Verification
hints.text: At the conclusion, return the maximum streak achieved if it is at least 3, otherwise return 0.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass streak tracker in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Subsequence solutions take quadratic time; contiguous subarrays can be resolved in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify contiguity requirement and apply a linear streak counter.
